snippet.title: A new railroad track building game [Constracktion trailer]
snippet.description:
Constracktion is a new track building and traffic optimization game where the goal is to connect industries across desert maps and help AI trains reach their destinations on time.

Wishlist and purchase on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3877410/Constracktion/

Discord: https://discord.gg/GYmXcDF523

Video music by @4thsgames
